description: This file defines the HuggingFaceInference class, which extends the LLM class to provide inference capabilities using Hugging Face models. It includes configuration options, environment variable handling for API keys, and methods for making text generation calls.

classes.name: HuggingFaceInference
classes.description: A class for interfacing with Hugging Face models for language inference, extending the base LLM class.

methods.name: _llmType
methods.description: Returns the type identifier for the LLM, which is 'hf'.

methods.name: _call
methods.description: Performs text generation by calling the Hugging Face inference API with the provided prompt and options.

methods.name: imports
methods.description: Dynamically imports the HfInference class from '@huggingface/inference' package.
